about: Every paper this repository prepares, and where each one stands. docs/PUBLISHING-PAPERS.md explains the steps and the statuses, following the GENChase runbook; python3 tools/paper_sync.py --check <id> checks an entry against its files. Update this file in the pull request that changes a status.

papers.title: Excluding Classical Cipher Families for the 1939 D'Agapeyeff Challenge: Key-Free Counts and Searches with Demonstrated Power
papers.summary: which classical cipher families the 1939 D'Agapeyeff challenge excludes, by key-free counts and by searches with demonstrated power
papers.note: Preprint 1.0.0 released on 8 October 2026 and archived on Zenodo (version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23241304; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23241303). Every quality item is closed; four in-project readings, no peer review.
